name: How long does it take to design and install a new irrigation system?
description: Design typically takes days to weeks, and installation for a residential system can range from one to three weeks, depending on project complexity.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to design and install a new irrigation system?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for irrigation system design and installation varies based on the property size, landscape complexity, and system features. Design can take a few days to a couple of weeks, depending on the detail required. Installation for a typical residential property might range from one to three weeks. Larger or more intricate projects, such as those involving smart controllers or specialized zones, could extend this timeframe. We provide a detailed project schedule after the initial site assessment.
